packs.name: Compact battery platform
packs.description: The compact battery platform: 21700 cylindrical cells in moulded holders under a sealed casing, taken apart on screen from the production CAD.
packs.intro: Cylindrical cells in moulded holders under a sealed casing, with the BMS and the harness carried inside the lid. One of our production platforms, drawn and assembled in house.

facts.label: Cells
facts.note: Held in moulded holders that space them apart and carry them through shock and vibration.

facts.label: Assembly
facts.note: Drawn from the production CAD, every part modelled.

facts.label: BMS
facts.note: The board handles protection and balancing, reachable without disturbing the cell stack.

packs.name: Heavy machinery platform
packs.description: The heavy machinery platform: EVE C40 prismatic cells clamped in a welded enclosure, taken apart on screen from the production CAD.
packs.intro: Prismatic cells clamped in a welded enclosure, with cell monitoring and the series busbars carried under a sealed lid. Built for machines that work a full shift and charge overnight.

facts.label: Cells
facts.note: A block held under compression, so the stack keeps its shape as the cells breathe.

facts.label: Assembly
facts.note: Drawn from the production CAD, every part modelled.

facts.label: Enclosure
facts.note: Built to live outdoors on a machine rather than in a cabinet.

packs.name: Heavy machinery chassis
packs.description: The heavy machinery chassis: a bend-plate battery that is part of the machine's structure, taken apart on screen from the production CAD.
packs.intro: A battery that is part of the machine's structure: a folded plate chassis carrying the service disconnect, the relays, the busbars and the BMS master on their own layer inside it.

facts.label: Build
facts.note: Folded from plate and bolted through flanges, so the battery carries load instead of hanging off a bracket.

facts.label: Assembly
facts.note: Drawn from the production CAD, every part modelled.

facts.label: Isolation
facts.note: A manual disconnect breaks the string before the pack is opened.

packs.name: UPS platform
packs.description: The UPS platform: a 19-inch rack battery unit, taken apart on screen from the production CAD.
packs.intro: A 19-inch rack unit: a sheet metal shell on rack brackets, insulated top and bottom, with forced air through the enclosure and status indication on the front.

still.alt: The UPS platform, a 19-inch rack battery unit

facts.label: Format
facts.note: A 2U rack unit on rack brackets, with status indication on the front.

facts.label: Assembly
facts.note: Drawn from the production CAD, every part modelled.

facts.label: Cooling

packs.name: AGV platform
packs.description: The AGV platform: a long, slim sealed pack for an automated guided vehicle, taken apart on screen from the production CAD.
packs.intro: A long, slim pack that drops into the frame of an automated guided vehicle: sealed case, padded internals, and a service lid that opens the parts a technician needs without opening the pack.

facts.label: Shape
facts.note: The space an AGV has: under the deck, between the wheels.

facts.label: Assembly
facts.note: Drawn from the production CAD, every part modelled.

facts.label: Service
facts.note: Routine work on the vehicle never breaks the seal on the pack.
